name: @shipworthy/openapi-fetch
description: Fast, type-safe fetch client for your OpenAPI schema. Only 6 kb (min). Works with React, Vue, Svelte, or vanilla JS.

scripts.generate-types: openapi generate typescript test/common/schemas/common.yaml -o test/common/schemas/common.d.ts && openapi generate typescript test/http-methods/schemas/get.yaml -o test/http-methods/schemas/get.d.ts && openapi generate typescript test/http-methods/schemas/put.yaml -o test/http-methods/schemas/put.d.ts && openapi generate typescript test/http-methods/schemas/post.yaml -o test/http-methods/schemas/post.d.ts && openapi generate typescript test/http-methods/schemas/delete.yaml -o test/http-methods/schemas/delete.d.ts && openapi generate typescript test/http-methods/schemas/options.yaml -o test/http-methods/schemas/options.d.ts && openapi generate typescript test/http-methods/schemas/head.yaml -o test/http-methods/schemas/head.d.ts && openapi generate typescript test/http-methods/schemas/patch.yaml -o test/http-methods/schemas/patch.d.ts && openapi generate typescript test/http-methods/schemas/trace.yaml -o test/http-methods/schemas/trace.d.ts && openapi generate typescript test/middleware/schemas/middleware.yaml -o test/middleware/schemas/middleware.d.ts && openapi generate typescript test/path-based-client/schemas/path-based-client.yaml -o test/path-based-client/schemas/path-based-client.d.ts && openapi generate typescript ../openapi-typescript/examples/github-api.yaml -o test/examples/schemas/github.d.ts && openapi generate typescript ../openapi-typescript/examples/stripe-api.yaml -o test/examples/schemas/stripe.d.ts && openapi generate typescript test/read-write-visibility/schemas/read-write.yaml -o test/read-write-visibility/schemas/read-write.d.ts --read-write-markers
scripts.test: bun run test:js && bun run test:exports
